status: Victory Road's cave tiled with 80 blocks, and the Route 1 mansion's ward stone; behaviour in sealed rock is EXP-033
note: Every Habitat Block the campaign places. A re-export erases blocks placed in game (EXP-021), so this manifest is the source: tools/habitat_blocks.py function writes the placement function, and the post-export procedure in docs/world-building/REEXPORT.md re-applies it and restarts the server so each block's chunk reloads. tools/validate_data.py checks the static rules, and checks presence in a stopped world passed with --world-save. Blocks placed on the disposable proof world for EXP-021 are not campaign blocks and are not listed.

fields.place: what the block gives its identity to
fields.style: natural (redirects the ambient spawns inside its range; EXP-021) or activated (keeps its own spawns alive round the block; staging 2026-09-26)
fields.replace_spawns: natural only: true replaces the ambient pool inside the range (EXP-021). Activated blocks: false
fields.range_of_influence: natural only: blocks; the measured edge is this value. Ranges of ReplaceSpawns blocks must not overlap (a sphere, 3D)
fields.status: planned (not in the world), placed (placed by the function), verified (presence and behaviour checked in game)
fields.mimic: activated only: the block it looks like (the trunk's log)
fields.activated: activated only: spawn_range (blocks round the block), max_spawns (alive at once), max_spawns_per_activation, chance, trigger (TICK), cancel_range (-1: ambient spawns continue)

blocks.place: the Route 1 mansion: the house's old ward, cracked in the landing floor (tools/route1_mansion.py WARD_STONE)
blocks.why: One block, not a lattice, so no seam inside the house falls back to the forest pool. Range 18 from the landing floor (between the storeys) reaches every standable floor cell of the house as a sphere or a column: the farthest interior corner is 15.1 blocks away horizontally and 5 below, 15.9 in all (EXP-021 measured the horizontal edge at the configured range; the vertical shape is EXP-033, unrun). Its edge falls inside the forest clearing (radius 22 round (1630, 5034), tools/maze_forest.py), so the ghosts keep to the house and its grounds and nothing reaches Route 1, 160 blocks away; no other block is within 36, so no ranges overlap.

blocks.place: the Route 1 world-tree sapling: inside its trunk, low, the clearing floor and branch floor
blocks.why: One of two activated blocks in the Route 1 sapling's trunk (log at every even y from 124 to 154 read on staging 2026-09-26, and y123-155 in the prefab as seated; kits/structures/prefabs/trees/tree_town/sapling_oak_a.json placed at y123 by tools/maze_forest.py): y134 reaches the clearing floor (y124) and the branch floor (y139-143), y150 the crown (y151-163). blocks.place: the birch elder elder_viltri_plateau_1: inside its trunk, low, forest floor to the first storey
blocks.why: One of four activated blocks up this elder's centre column: ground + 12, + 35 and + 58 in the solid trunk core (log to ground + 59 in every elder prefab as seated) and + 74 inside the crown's leaves (leaves from + 63 to + 81 at every elder's centre, staging probe 2026-09-26; the crown's top surface is + 81/+ 82, which the top block's 16-block reach covers). A nest, not a share of the forest's spawns (the owner, 2026-09-26: 'a person [should] see and feel like a sapling belongs to a species'; 'at least 20 ... spread vertically along the tree'; 'increasing spawn rates could help, and making sure we have spawns at the top of the tree'). Each block keeps up to 8 of the tree's bird alive within 16 blocks of it, about 32 per tree, refilling up to 2 at a time as birds are caught or despawn: Cobblemon 1.8.0's activated style counts only its spawned entities that still exist. Activated blocks do not cancel each other, unlike overlapping natural ReplaceSpawns blocks (EXP-021). Staging, 2026-09-26: the three-block nest (7 each) held 23 Fletchling round the birch at (1730, 3960), most of them drifting to the forest floor within a minute; Cobblemon has no perching behaviour, and the owner kept the birds' own behaviour. Pool and bird: docs/world-building/SAPLING_BIRDS.md.

Each block keeps up to 8 of the tree's bird alive within 16 blocks of it, about 32 per tree, refilling up to 2 at a time as birds are caught or despawn: Cobblemon 1.8.0's activated style counts only its spawned entities that still exist. Activated blocks do not cancel each other, unlike overlapping natural ReplaceSpawns blocks (EXP-021). Staging, 2026-09-26: the three-block nest (7 each) held 23 Fletchling round the birch at (1730, 3960), most of them drifting to the forest floor within a minute; Cobblemon has no perching behaviour, and the owner kept the birds' own behaviour. Pool and bird: docs/world-building/SAPLING_BIRDS.md.

blocks.why: One of four activated blocks up this elder's centre column: ground + 12, + 35 and + 58 in the solid trunk core (log to ground + 59 in every elder prefab as seated) and + 74 inside the crown's leaves (leaves from + 63 to + 81 at every elder's centre, staging probe 2026-09-26; the crown's top surface is + 81/+ 82, which the top block's 16-block reach covers). A nest, not a share of the forest's spawns (the owner, 2026-09-26: 'a person [should] see and feel like a sapling belongs to a species'; 'at least 20 ... spread vertically along the tree'; 'increasing spawn rates could help, and making sure we have spawns at the top of the tree'). Each block keeps up to 8 of the tree's bird alive within 16 blocks of it, about 32 per tree, refilling up to 2 at a time as birds are caught or despawn: Cobblemon 1.8.0's activated style counts only its spawned entities that still exist. Activated blocks do not cancel each other, unlike overlapping natural ReplaceSpawns blocks (EXP-021). Staging, 2026-09-26: the three-block nest (7 each) held 23 Fletchling round the birch at (1730, 3960), most of them drifting to the forest floor within a minute; Cobblemon has no perching behaviour, and the owner kept the birds' own behaviour. blocks.why: One of four activated blocks up this elder's centre column: ground + 12, + 35 and + 58 in the solid trunk core (log to ground + 59 in every elder prefab as seated) and + 74 inside the crown's leaves (leaves from + 63 to + 81 at every elder's centre, staging probe 2026-09-26; the crown's top surface is + 81/+ 82, which the top block's 16-block reach covers). A nest, not a share of the forest's spawns (the owner, 2026-09-26: 'a person [should] see and feel like a sapling belongs to a species'; 'at least 20 ... spread vertically along the tree'; 'increasing spawn rates could help, and making sure we have spawns at the top of the tree'). Each block keeps up to 8 of the tree's bird alive within 16 blocks of it, about 32 per tree, refilling up to 2 at a time as birds are caught or despawn: Cobblemon 1.8.0's activated style counts only its spawned entities that still exist. Activated blocks do not cancel each other, unlike overlapping natural ReplaceSpawns blocks (EXP-021). Staging, 2026-09-26: the three-block nest (7 each) held 23 Fletchling round the birch at (1730, 3960), most of them drifting to the forest floor within a minute; Cobblemon has no perching behaviour, and the owner kept the birds' own behaviour. A nest, not a share of the forest's spawns (the owner, 2026-09-26: 'a person [should] see and feel like a sapling belongs to a species'; 'at least 20 ... spread vertically along the tree'; 'increasing spawn rates could help, and making sure we have spawns at the top of the tree'). Each block keeps up to 8 of the tree's bird alive within 16 blocks of it, about 32 per tree, refilling up to 2 at a time as birds are caught or despawn: Cobblemon 1.8.0's activated style counts only its spawned entities that still exist. Activated blocks do not cancel each other, unlike overlapping natural ReplaceSpawns blocks (EXP-021). Staging, 2026-09-26: the three-block nest (7 each) held 23 Fletchling round the birch at (1730, 3960), most of them drifting to the forest floor within a minute; Cobblemon has no perching behaviour, and the owner kept the birds' own behaviour. Pool and bird: docs/world-building/SAPLING_BIRDS.md.

blocks.why: One of four activated blocks up this elder's centre column: ground + 12, + 35 and + 58 in the solid trunk core (log to ground + 59 in every elder prefab as seated) and + 74 inside the crown's leaves (leaves from + 63 to + 81 at every elder's centre, staging probe 2026-09-26; the crown's top surface is + 81/+ 82, which the top block's 16-block reach covers). A nest, not a share of the forest's spawns (the owner, 2026-09-26: 'a person [should] see and feel like a sapling belongs to a species'; 'at least 20 ... spread vertically along the tree'; 'increasing spawn rates could help, and making sure we have spawns at the top of the tree'). Each block keeps up to 8 of the tree's bird alive within 16 blocks of it, about 32 per tree, refilling up to 2 at a time as birds are caught or despawn: Cobblemon 1.8.0's activated style counts only its spawned entities that still exist. Activated blocks do not cancel each other, unlike overlapping natural ReplaceSpawns blocks (EXP-021). Staging, 2026-09-26: the three-block nest (7 each) held 23 Fletchling round the birch at (1730, 3960), most of them drifting to the forest floor within a minute; Cobblemon has no perching behaviour, and the owner kept the birds' own behaviour. Pool and bird: docs/world-building/SAPLING_BIRDS.md.

blocks.place: the Ursaluna's den west of Highwire, the slope in front of the mouth (data/ursaluna_cave.json)
blocks.why: Teddiursa on the den's outskirts (the owner, 2026-10-02). ACTIVATED since the owner walked the slope the same day and 'didnt see ... many teddiursa spawns': as a natural ReplaceSpawns block (range 20) it only swapped the species natural spawning happened to pick, and staging measured 0 Pokemon within 32 of it. Activated, it keeps up to 4 Teddiursa (data/ursaluna_cave.json teddiursa.group) alive within 16 blocks, refilling 2 at a time as they are caught or despawn, the elder nests' and Driftmouth Isle's settings (spawn_range 16, chance 1.0, TICK). cancel_range -1, as on the elders: the tri-peaks' own spawns continue round it; the cubs are added, not substituted. Kept at the SAME position, in the ground's own top block on the cave's axis 14 blocks out from the mouth (tools/ground.py: y158), so the activated placement's first setblock (the mimic) overwrites the natural block already there on staging and no stale one is left. Its 16 reach the mouth (15.0 away, from the block centre to the mouth's standing block) and stop 39 blocks short of the hall (55.4 away, tools/ursaluna_cave_audit.py), far outside the bear's wake. Mimic: grass, the hill's own skin as data/ursaluna_cave.json describes it (keep_natural_top_why), NOT read from a world; if the slope there is another block, this one field changes. Activated blocks cancel nothing and are cancelled by nothing (EXP-021), and the nearest other Habitat Block is 360 blocks away.
blocks.mimic_why: the den's rocky apron: probed in staging 2026-10-02, the 24 columns round this block at y158 are 10 stone, 8 cobblestone and 6 other; a grass_block disguise set the same day read as a lone grass tile there. Stone is also what this block was before (no mimic set, the default; MimicId minecraft:stone read off it that morning).

ACTIVATED, the Lopunny cellar's and the Ursaluna den's pattern: up to 6 alive at once, refilled 2 at a time as they are caught or despawn, TICK at chance 1. The position is the fold floor's centre in the ground's own top block (tools/ground.py: y98), which tools/drovers_hollow.py writes as coarse dirt; that pack must run BEFORE R9E (step R9HF) or it writes the floor back over this block. spawn_range 6: the activated spawner searches a box of spawn_range round the block (docs/research/notes/habitat-nest-perching.md 4, ActivatedHabitatSpawning.kt), and 6 keeps that box (x3965-3977, z6035-6047) inside the fold's fence (interior x3963-3979, z6035-6047), so every place a Pokemon can be put is in the pen; nothing is under it (the old working runs at z6019-6027) and the barn's floor (z6016-6030) is outside it (tools/drovers_hollow_audit.py checks every standing place in the box). cancel_range 11: the pack's natural spawns are cancelled in a sphere of 11 round the block, which takes in the whole pen (its far interior corner is 10.7 away) and the lane, and not the barn's floor (12.3 away at the nearest). Nothing holds a Pokemon in afterwards but the fence (the same note: no tether exists for wild spawns). The nearest other Habitat Block is sapling_storm_rift_foot_low, 243 blocks away (measured 2026-10-02 from this file's positions).
blocks.mimic_why: the fold's own floor block (tools/drovers_hollow.py writes coarse dirt in the ground's top block across the pen), so the block is one more patch of trodden earth.

blocks.place: Shrew Station's study pool off the west coast (data/research_station.json study_pool): in the post under the study deck's middle, mid-water
blocks.why: A few Horsea kept in the station's study pool (docs/world-building/RESEARCH_STATION.md section 5.3, the Seaward Drift's precedent: a water Habitat Block). ACTIVATED, up to 4 alive at once, one at a time. The position is the middle of the post tools/research_station.py sets under the study deck's centre (456, 2828): the sea floor there is y57 (heightmap, rounded), 5 under the sea's y62, the post runs y58-61 and the block replaces its middle; the pack must run BEFORE R9E or it writes the post back over this block. spawn_range 8 reaches the water round the deck (its 17 by 17 box, x448-464, z2820-2836, is 289 water columns 3-8 deep, measured 2026-10-02); cancel_range 8 holds the shallows band's natural pool off it. The nearest other Habitat Block is elder_lake_viltri_hollow_1, 898 blocks away (measured from this file's positions). Moved 2026-10-02 from Shrew Lake's lagoon (2574, 103, 4114), where it kept Psyduck, when the owner moved the station to the coast; tools/research_station.py cleanup puts that cell back to lake water on staging. In-water activated spawning is not verified (the Drift's caveat).
